members.name: Aldric Marrow
members.role: Reeve of Brackenford; keeps the gate-due and the town ledger; took the Coldwell fields for the town store in the Lean Year; old, and has not named who comes after him
ties: rival of Mercy Abbot over the gate-due
holds Thornby's debt against Osric Dunn
outlawed Marta Hale and her household
the broken match shamed him before Josiah Crane

members.name: Cuth Marrow
members.role: Aldric's wife; tends the sick of the town with the chapel sisters; keeps a quiet house

members.name: Maud Marrow
members.role: Aldric's daughter; keeps the market rolls and the gate ledger under her father's eye
ties: SECRET: copies the ledger for Mercy Abbot when her father is asleep

members.name: Wenna Marrow
members.role: Tobin's wife, a weaver's daughter who farms the Marrow strip; expecting their first child
ties: knows the town thinks she cost it the Kettlebridge peace

members.name: Tobin Marrow
members.role: captain of the gate guards and the Reeve's son; broke his promise to marry Hester Crane two years ago and married Wenna
ties: commands Wat Fenner at the gate
thinks the outlaws must be cleared from the stone road

members.name: Mercy Abbot
members.role: head of the Market Guild; wants the gate-due dropped and trade with Kettlebridge back; holds the lease of the old Coldwell fields, which the Tolleys farm for the Guild
ties: trades with Silas Pike and wants more of his stone

members.name: Osric Abbot
members.role: Mercy's husband; makes the market stalls and the guildhall benches; no love for the Reeve

members.name: Linnet Abbot
members.role: Mercy's daughter; minds the Guild's stall in the square and learns the market terms

members.name: Agnes Fenner
members.role: cook at the inn; Marta Hale's younger sister; grew up at Coldwell
ties: SECRET: carries food out to Coldwell by the south gate when Wat is not on watch; Marta knows, Wat does not

members.name: Wat Fenner
members.role: gate guard at the south gate on the stone road; collects the gate-due from carters
ties: brother-in-law of Marta Hale, an outlaw
takes the due from Silas Pike

members.name: Bram Fenner
members.role: Wat and Agnes's son; plays at the gate and knows the guards' names

members.name: Sissly Fenner
members.role: Wat and Agnes's daughter; follows her mother about the inn kitchen

members.name: Sister Elspeth
members.role: eldest sister of the chapel; keeps the common fire and the calendar; heals anyone who comes, outlaws included
ties: tended Marta Hale's son through a fever at Coldwell last winter

members.name: Sister Alys
members.role: younger sister of the chapel; keeps the herb garden and the chapel's store of salves
ties: SECRET: doubts the Reeve's right to the Coldwell fields

members.name: Sister Perrin
members.role: chapel sister; keeps the common fire lit and the calendar of feast days

members.name: Marta Tolley
members.role: Hal's wife; works the Coldwell fields and keeps the house; wants a wall round the yard

members.name: Tib Tolley
members.role: Hal and Marta's son; helps in the fields and keeps watch from the barn

members.name: Nell Tolley
members.role: Hal and Marta's daughter; afraid of the woods and the people in them

members.name: Osbert Ashby
members.role: farms the Ashby meadows outside the walls; sells grain to the town store and the Guild
ties: sells grain to Aldric Marrow's store

members.name: Edith Ashby
members.role: Osbert's wife; keeps the dairy and the hens

members.name: Roland Ashby
members.role: Osbert's son; ploughs and reaps and wants a strip of his own

members.name: Godric Rowan
members.role: farms the Rowan strip on the north field; sells grain to the town store and the Guild; proud of his land
ties: sells grain to Aldric Marrow's store
wants his son to take the strip

members.name: Elfgifu Rowan
members.role: Godric's wife; keeps the dairy and the orchard; makes a little cider for the market
ties: trades cider at the Guild stall

members.name: Wulf Rowan
members.role: Godric and Elfgifu's son; ploughs the north field and wants to marry and take a strip of his own

members.name: Leofric Rowan
members.role: Godric and Elfgifu's younger son; helps with the beasts and dreams of the gate guards

members.name: Edwin Marsh
members.role: farms the Marsh acres by the east gate; keeps a few sheep and sells wool to the weavers
ties: sells wool to the weavers' wives

members.name: Sigrid Marsh
members.role: Edwin's wife; cooks for the gate guards' mess and keeps the house; known for her barley broth

members.name: Hilda Marsh
members.role: Edwin and Sigrid's daughter; works the sheep and the wool; being courted by Wulf Rowan
ties: helps her mother cook for the guards

members.name: Aethelred Tanner
members.role: keeps the tannery by the west wall; buys hides from the farms and sells leather to the Guild; a hard bargainer
ties: sells leather to Mercy Abbot's Guild
rival of the Kettlebridge leather sellers

members.name: Mildred Tanner
members.role: Aethelred's wife; keeps the house and the tannery books; a sharp eye for a bad hide

members.name: Cedric Tanner
members.role: Aethelred and Mildred's son; makes cart frames and barrels; wants to build houses but the town is short of stone
ties: wants to build in stone if he can get it

members.name: Baldwin Wade
members.role: keeps the Bell and Bush inn on the square; hears everything and says little; the inn is where the town argues
ties: owes Aldric Marrow a favour for the licence

members.name: Petra Wade
members.role: Baldwin's wife; runs the inn kitchen and the girls who serve; famous for her pies

members.name: Gareth Wade
members.role: Baldwin and Petra's son; a gate guard who would rather keep the inn; drinks too much of his father's ale
ties: SECRET: owes money to a Kettlebridge carter and cannot pay

members.name: Reginald Hobson
members.role: the town's mason; repairs the walls and the chapel; forever short of good stone and cursing the Kettlebridge price
ties: works for Aldric Marrow on the walls
thinks the gate-due is robbery on his trade

members.name: Joan Hobson
members.role: Reginald's wife; a midwife who works with the chapel sisters; has delivered half the town

members.name: Stephen Hobson
members.role: Reginald and Joan's son; learns his father's trade and wants to build something grander than a wall

members.name: Aldous Fletcher
members.role: makes bows and arrows for the guards and the hunters; works from a shed by the north gate

members.name: Enid Fletcher
members.role: Aldous's wife; keeps a stall in the square selling odds and ends and the bows her husband makes
ties: minds a stall in the square

members.name: Robin Fletcher
members.role: Aldous and Enid's son; helps in the shed and is a fair shot with a small bow

members.name: Herbert Carter
members.role: farms the Carter fields south of the wall; keeps a cart and hires out to carry goods to the gate
ties: hires his cart to the Guild
pays the gate-due on his own loads

members.name: Cecily Carter
members.role: Herbert's wife; keeps the hens and the vegetable plot; sells eggs in the square
ties: sells eggs at the Guild stall

members.name: Alfred Carter
members.role: Herbert and Cecily's son; drives the cart and wants to be a carter on the stone road
ties: helps his father on the cart

members.name: Edith Carter
members.role: Herbert and Cecily's daughter; helps with the hens and the eggs

members.name: Osgood Baker
members.role: keeps the town bakehouse; bakes the bread for the market and the guards; up before dawn every day
ties: supplies bread to the gate guards
owes Aldric Marrow for the bakehouse lease

members.name: Amice Baker
members.role: Osgood's wife; runs the bakehouse with him and keeps the accounts in her head

members.name: Godfrey Baker
members.role: Osgood and Amice's son; bakes the night batch and wants to take over the bakehouse one day

members.name: Aldith Weaver
members.role: a weaver; Wenna Marrow's mother; weaves cloth for the market and has not forgiven the town for its talk about her daughter
ties: trades cloth at the Guild stall
SECRET: thinks Tobin Marrow ruined her daughter's name

members.name: Leofwine Weaver
members.role: Aldith's husband; makes looms and repairs the market stalls; a quiet man who keeps his opinions to himself

members.name: Edwin Potter
members.role: makes and sells pots and jugs at the square; his clay comes from Kettlebridge and the gate-due eats his profit

members.name: Alice Potter
members.role: Edwin's wife; keeps the house and helps at the stall; a good hand with a glaze

members.name: Anselm Potter
members.role: Edwin and Alice's son; plays in the clay and breaks as many pots as he makes

members.name: Wilfred Smith
members.role: a builder who puts up houses and barns; works in timber because stone is dear; has a long memory for the Kettlebridge price

members.name: Hilda Smith
members.role: Wilfred's wife; a healer who sets bones and tends wounds; the guards come to her when they are hurt

members.name: Osbert Smith
members.role: Wilfred and Hilda's son; builds with his father and wants to learn stonework from the Kettlebridge masons

members.name: Benedict Cooper
members.role: the town cooper; makes barrels for the inn and the market; his barrels carry the town's ale and berries
ties: owes Aethelred Tanner for leather bindings

members.name: Juliana Cooper
members.role: Benedict's wife; keeps a stall selling barrels, buckets and wooden wares

members.name: Martin Cooper
members.role: Benedict and Juliana's son; a cooper's apprentice who wants to be a master

members.name: Godwin Miller
members.role: keeps the mill by the river and grinds the town's grain; takes his toll in flour and is thought to take a little more
ties: suspected of taking too much toll
owes Aldric Marrow for the mill lease

members.name: Ethel Miller
members.role: Godwin's wife; bakes and sells flour cakes at the mill gate

members.name: Hugh Miller
members.role: Godwin and Ethel's son; runs the mill with his father and wants the mill to be his

members.name: Beorn Beornson
members.role: a hunter who keeps the wolves off the town road and sells venison in the square; knows the woods better than anyone
ties: knows the Coldwell outlaws by sight

members.name: Sigrun Beornson
members.role: Beorn's wife; sells his venison and hides at the market stall; a sharp trader
ties: sells venison at the Guild stall

members.name: Ulf Beornson
members.role: Beorn and Sigrun's son; follows his father into the woods and is learning to set snares

members.name: Edric Grey
members.role: a gate guard at the north gate; checks the loads and counts the due; a quiet man who does his duty
ties: SECRET: lets a Kettlebridge carter through without the due for a bribe

members.name: Mildgyth Grey
members.role: Edric's wife; cooks for the gate guards' mess with Sigrid Marsh

members.name: Aelfric Grey
members.role: Edric and Mildgyth's son; plays at the north gate and knows the guards' names

members.name: Walter Stanhope
members.role: a gate guard at the south gate; collects the due alongside Wat Fenner; a big man with a short temper
ties: works the south gate with Wat Fenner
drinks at the Bell and Bush

members.name: Edith Stanhope
members.role: Walter's wife; keeps the house and sells pies at the gate to travellers

members.name: Godiva Stanhope
members.role: Walter and Edith's daughter; helps her mother with the pies and wants to work at the inn
ties: wants to work at the inn

members.name: Sweyn Holm
members.role: fishes the river and the north shore; sells his catch in the square; a quiet man who keeps to his boat
ties: owes the fishmonger's stall rent to the Guild

members.name: Astrid Holm
members.role: Sweyn's wife; smokes and sells the fish; keeps the house by the river
ties: sells fish at the Guild stall

members.name: Knut Holm
members.role: Sweyn and Astrid's son; plays by the river and is never far from the water

members.name: Alwin Wren
members.role: an old healer who lives alone by the chapel; knows herbs and old charms; the sisters consult him and the Reeve does not
ties: SECRET: keeps a book of charms the chapel would call heathen

members.name: Pernel Pip
members.role: a young scribe who keeps the market tolls and writes letters for those who cannot; lodges with the chapel sisters
ties: SECRET: in love with Gareth Wade, who does not know

members.name: Simon Hollis
members.role: a pedlar who walks the roads to Thornby and the hamlets, carrying Brackenford goods and bringing fish and news back
ties: trades with Osric Dunn at Thornby
pays the gate-due on his loads
brings news of the outlaws to the Reeve

members.name: Avice Hollis
members.role: Simon's wife; keeps the house and a small stall of dried goods; worries when he is on the road

members.name: Nicholas Hollis
members.role: Simon and Avice's son; walks the road with his father and learns the trade
ties: walks the road with his father

situations.summary: Mercy Abbot's Market Guild wants the gate-due dropped to bring Kettlebridge trade back; Reeve Aldric Marrow keeps it to pay the gate guards who keep the road clear of wolves and outlaws. The square is split between them.

sides.Aldric Marrow: The due pays the guards and keeps the road safe; Mercy would sell the town's safety for Kettlebridge coin.
sides.Mercy Abbot: The due drives carters away and makes enemies of Kettlebridge; the Guild's trade suffers and the town grows poorer.
sides.Wat Fenner: Collects the due at the south gate and knows the guards' pay depends on it; dislikes the sour looks from carters.
sides.Tobin Marrow: Supports his father's due; the guards answer to him and he will not see them unpaid.

situations.summary: The old Coldwell fields, taken by the town store in the Lean Year and leased to the Market Guild, are farmed by Hal Tolley. Marta Hale's outlaws still live at Coldwell and want the fields back; the Tolleys fear them and the Reeve calls them thieves.

sides.Marta Hale: The fields were ours before the Lean Year; we were not paid for them and we will not be starved off them.
sides.Hal Tolley: I farm what the Guild leased me; the Hales had their chance to leave and chose outlawry.
sides.Mercy Abbot: Holds the lease and takes the rent; the fields are lawful Guild land now, whatever the Hales say.
sides.Aldric Marrow: Took the fields for the town store when the Hales could not pay; they were declared outlaws when they would not leave.

situations.summary: Agnes Fenner carries food out to Coldwell by the south gate when Wat is not on watch; her sister Marta knows, her husband Wat does not.

sides.Agnes Fenner: Marta is my sister and her boy was sick; I will not let them starve, but Wat must never know or he could lose his post.
sides.Marta Hale: Agnes brings what she can; I do not ask her to risk more, and I tell no one where it comes from.

situations.summary: Two years ago Tobin Marrow broke his promise to Hester Crane and married Wenna, shaming Josiah Crane and setting Brackenford and Kettlebridge at odds. Wenna feels the town's blame; Tobin stands by his choice.

sides.Tobin Marrow: I broke the match because I would not marry where I did not love; Wenna is my wife and I will not hear her slighted.
sides.Wenna Marrow: The town thinks I cost it the Kettlebridge peace; I keep to the Marrow strip and say little.
sides.Hester Crane: Tobin shamed me before both towns; I keep the foundry books and will not forget it.
sides.Josiah Crane: Aldric's son insulted my house; Kettlebridge remembers, and stone goes south now as much as north.

situations.summary: Thornby owes Brackenford's town store forty baskets of grain from the Lean Year and pays slowly in fish. The ledger records it; Osric Dunn feels the weight of it.

sides.Aldric Marrow: The debt is in the ledger; Thornby pays in fish and the store waits, but it is not forgotten.
sides.Osric Dunn: Forty baskets is more than Thornby can spare; we pay in fish and the ledger still says we owe.

situations.summary: Ezra Holt led the quarry cutting that broke into a giants' cairn; the giants' elder Hollbrenna closed the shelf to Kettlebridge. Ezra says he did not know; Orrum wants him to answer for it.

sides.Ezra Holt: I did not know the stones were a cairn; I would never have cut there had I known, and I am afraid of what the giants may do.
sides.Hollbrenna: My grandmother lies in that cairn; the shelf is closed to Kettlebridge until the cutting is answered for.
sides.Orrum: Ezra Holt cut into our dead; he must answer, and I will see that he does.
sides.Tavvik: The elder forbade trade, but Kettlebridge needs meat and I need timber; I carry on the track against her word.

situations.summary: The Lakemead was common grazing for Elmwick and Reedmoor; Nell Sedge let it to the Coombes for grain, and Hob Garrow says it was never Reedmoor's to let. Fences have been pulled down twice.

sides.Hob Garrow: The Lakemead was Elmwick's common and I grazed it as a boy; Nell Sedge had no right to let it.
sides.Nell Sedge: Reedmoor has let the meadow for years and the Coombes pay their rent in grain; Elmwick can quarrel with the deed.
sides.Jem Coombe: I farm the meadow and pay Nell Sedge; Elmwick folk have pulled down my fence twice and I want peace to farm.
sides.Thistle Mossfoot: I trade with both villages and am friendly with the Coombes; I wish they would settle it without me in the middle.

situations.summary: Thornby says old Edda at the north light lit it wrong on purpose to wreck boats; Edda says she lights it every night. Osric Dunn's brother's boat was lost and he holds her to blame.

sides.Edda Wray: I light the lamp every night as I have for years; the sea took Osric's brother, not I.
sides.Osric Dunn: My brother's boat went on the rocks below her light; she lit it wrong and Thornby knows it.

situations.summary: Wulf Rowan and Hilda Marsh are courting; both families expect a match, but Godric Rowan wants his son to wait until the harvest and Edwin Marsh wants the wool secured first.

sides.Wulf Rowan: I want to marry Hilda now and take a strip of my own; my father says wait for the harvest.
sides.Hilda Marsh: I love Wulf and would marry him tomorrow, but my father wants the wool settled first and I will not cross him.
sides.Godric Rowan: The boy is young and the harvest uncertain; a wedding can wait until the grain is in.
sides.Edwin Marsh: Wulf is a good lad, but I want the wool clip secured before I lose my daughter's hands.

situations.summary: Godwin Miller is suspected of taking more than his lawful toll from the town's grain; the Reeve has not called him to account, but the Guild has noticed and Mercy Abbot is asking questions.

sides.Godwin Miller: I take only what is my due for the mill; the Guild counts flour and thinks every sack is short.
sides.Aldric Marrow: The mill is leased from the town and the toll is set; if Godwin is taking more, it is a matter for the ledger.
sides.Mercy Abbot: The Guild's grain comes back short from the mill and I want to know why; the Reeve will not look.

situations.summary: Aldith Weaver, Wenna's mother, blames Tobin Marrow for the town's talk about her daughter; she will not sell cloth to the Marrow household and says so in the square.

sides.Aldith Weaver: Tobin broke his promise and my daughter wears the shame of it; I will not sell him so much as a rag.
sides.Tobin Marrow: My mother-in-law will not forgive me for the match, though Wenna is my wife and I keep her well.
sides.Wenna Marrow: My mother means well but her grudge makes the talk worse; I wish she would let it lie.

situations.summary: Reginald Hobson owes Silas Pike for the last load of stone and cannot pay until the Reeve settles the wall account; Silas is pressing him.

sides.Reginald Hobson: The stone is in the wall and the Reeve has not paid me for the work; Silas wants his marks and I have none.
sides.Silas Pike: I carried the stone and paid the due on it; Hobson owes me and I will not be put off again.
sides.Aldric Marrow: The wall account is in the ledger and will be settled when the store has the marks; the mason can wait.
